params.name: Hallard Lanner
params.note: CONCEPT, generated by scripts/shapes/concepts/lanner.mjs (edit that, not this). A two-seat mini VTOL built like a long-nosed grand tourer: an oval mouth in a chrome ring, round lamps under glass covers, a long louvred bonnet with a power bulge, the cab two thirds back, a fastback roof down to a cut-off tail with two round lamps a side, long front-hinged doors, four ducted fans at the corners where the wheels would be, a pusher in the tail panel and three feet with mag-lock pucks. 4.9 m long. docs/proposals/hover-cars.md.

parts.name: body
parts.note: The shell. The glass is the loft's own faces, glazed (cabin-lanner.js). Seams, louvres, lamps and chrome are separate parts laid a hair proud of it.
